description: This file contains utility functions for file handling, input validation, and security in the context of a web application. It includes functions for validating printable characters, IP addresses, URLs, MAC addresses, ports, IDs, time ranges, days, SSID names, and sanitizing strings. Additionally, it initializes a CSRF protection library and manages localization settings.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Validates if the input string contains only printable ASCII characters within a specified range.

methods.name: noSpace
methods.description: Checks if the input contains at least one non-whitespace character.

methods.name: validIPAddr
methods.description: Validates if an IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) is correctly formatted.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates if a link matches the URL component pattern.

methods.name: validMAC
methods.description: Validates if a MAC address is correctly formatted and not a multicast address.

methods.name: validPort
methods.description: Checks if a port number is within the valid range 1-65535.

methods.name: validId
methods.description: Validates if an ID is in the range 1-256.

methods.name: validId_PC
methods.description: Validates if a parental control ID is in range, possibly multiple IDs separated by underscores.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: isValInRange
methods.description: Verifies if a value lies within a specified minimum and maximum.

methods.name: validURL
methods.description: Validates if a URL is well-formed according to complex regex patterns.

methods.name: validTime
methods.description: Checks if start time is less than end time within a 24-hour range.

methods.name: validDays
methods.description: Validates if days are among the accepted days of the week.

methods.name: valid_ssid_name
methods.description: Validates SSID names based on length, reserved prefixes, and forbidden substrings.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Ensures the string does not contain forbidden special characters.

methods.name: remove_special_char
methods.description: Checks for presence of certain special characters, possibly for sanitization.
